name: an absolute path is read from the root
catches: shows a regular text file named by its path from the instance root, and nothing named any other way

name: a real path outside the instance is shown
catches: follows a symlink inside the instance and refuses one or a climb that leads out of it

name: a .git directory is shown
catches: never shows the instance's Claude Code home, a .git directory, a .env file or a .credentials.json, however it is reached

name: a directory is read as a file
catches: shows regular files only, of at most the largest size, and text only

name: a file twice the largest size is shown
catches: shows regular files only, of at most the largest size, and text only

name: a NUL near the start is taken for text
catches: shows regular files only, of at most the largest size, and text only

name: a row goes out without the paths it names
catches: finds in a row's words exactly the paths it shows, and leaves a row with none as it was

name: a markdown file is drawn as code
catches: renders a markdown file as markdown, its own paths linked only where the view shows them

name: the fence is always three backticks
catches: wraps a code file in one fenced block with its language tag, a fence longer than any run of backticks in it

name: a path not shown answers 200
catches: answers a path it does not show with its status and the reason, and nothing of the file

name: the view carries no theme script
catches: links only the stylesheets and the theme script the server serves, and nothing inline

name: the view leaves an installed app's title bar to the manifest
catches: gives an installed app's title bar the theme's colour, as the page does
